description: GoiEner and the University of Deusto publish a tariff-change survey linked to household electricity summaries. The deposit combines questionnaire answers with consumption before and after a change from flat-rate to time-of-use pricing. Documented fields include peak, flat and valley consumption, costs, household energy-budget responses and energy-poverty indicators for comparison periods spanning June 2019 to May 2022. A Zstandard-compressed CSV and Spanish questionnaire PDF are publicly available. Access is free, but metadata state CC BY 4.0 while the description states CC-BY-SA without a version. The data can inform behavioural demand-response simulations alongside data-goiener-smart-meter-data-spain and model-pypsa. A caveat is that a cooperative survey and before/after comparison do not isolate tariff causality from other changes. The licence conflict and sampling design require attention before reuse. No responses were downloaded.
